willReceiveByRule: Learners on this course will receive certificates once they meet the rule below.
earnHeading: How do learners earn the certificate?

PROGRESS.label: Course progress
PROGRESS.description: Complete a set percentage of the course, as before.

SCORE.label: Marks in tests
SCORE.description: Pass the quizzes and assessments you choose, whatever their course progress.

PROGRESS_AND_SCORE.label: Progress and marks
PROGRESS_AND_SCORE.description: Complete the course percentage and pass the tests.

scope.ALL: Every quiz and assessment in this course
scope.CUSTOM: Only the modules, chapters or tests I pick

typesHint: A whole course, module or chapter counts these kinds of test inside it, including ones added later. A test you tick yourself always counts.

picker.error: Could not load this course's tests.
picker.empty: This course has no quizzes or assessments yet. Add a Quiz or Assessment slide first.

ruleHeading: To earn the certificate, a learner must

rule.AVERAGE: Reach an average score across the tests

useOwnPass: Use a quiz's own pass % when it has one (this mark covers the rest)

summary.none: No published test matches this rule yet, so nobody can earn the certificate until one does.

notes: A learner's best attempt counts. Assessment marks count only after they are released to the learner. Tests not attempted count as 0 in an average.

errors.pickTests: Pick at least one module, chapter or test.
